name: Banana Pudding Bars
desc: Vanilla wafer crust under a banana pudding and cream cheese layer with fresh bananas and whipped cream.

source.title: Banana Pudding Bars
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 (11 oz) box vanilla wafers, 8-12 set aside for topping
1 (5.1 oz) package instant banana pudding mix
3 medium ripe bananas, sliced 1/4 in thick

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13 in pan with parchment, leaving an overhang on two sides.
Pulse the vanilla wafers (minus the ones set aside) in a food processor to fine crumbs. Stir in the melted butter and sugar until it looks like wet sand.
Press the crumbs firmly into the pan. Bake 9 min, until lightly golden. Cool completely on a rack, about 30 min.
Beat the cream cheese until smooth, then add the pudding mix and cold milk and beat on low until thick and smooth.
Spread half the filling over the cooled crust, lay the banana slices on top, and cover them completely with the rest of the filling.
Whip the heavy cream, powdered sugar and vanilla to stiff peaks and spread over the filling.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hr, best overnight.
Crumble the reserved wafers over the top, lift the bars out by the parchment, and cut into squares with a sharp knife, wiping it between cuts.
tips: The creator's current website version is larger: two 3.4 oz boxes of pudding, 16 oz cream cheese, 1/2 cup milk and 2 cups cream, with the second pudding box stabilizing the whipped cream in place of powdered sugar.
Cover the bananas completely with filling so they do not brown.

references.title: Banana Pudding Bars Recipe
references.usedFor: 9x13 in parchment-lined pan, wet-sand crumb texture, layering order, 4 hr chill, reserving 8-12 wafers
